MIGraphX dynamic-shape compile fails on ResNet-50: fused concat+pointwise JIT kernel generated with wrong arity (needs >=7 args, 4 provided) on gfx90a/ROCm 7.2.1/MIGraphX 2.15. Fixed-batch compiles fine; trivial dynamic CNN works. Reproducer+writeup: findings/migraphx-trt-shim-gaps/. Blocks dynamic batch on concat-heavy real models in trt-shim-rocm.

MIGraphX segfaults evaluating a dynamic-dim program compiled with offload_copy=false: crash in op::select_module::compute -> shape::operator== (dynamic dispatch). offload_copy=true dynamic works; offload_copy=false static works; only dynamic+offload_copy=false crashes. Forces trt-shim-rocm to keep dynamic engines on the non-graph-capturable offload_copy=true host-staging path (static engines use offload_copy=false zero-copy + HIP graph capture). gfx90a/ROCm 7.2.1/MIGraphX 2.15. Repro: compile any dynamic-batch ONNX with offload_copy=false, eval.

OIDN-GPU denoiser on ROCm for barney's AMD backends: the cuda backend ships a no-op denoiser which the HIP build reuses; OIDN has a HIP/ROCm device (BARNEY_OIDN_GPU) to wire up as an enhancement. Not required for the correctness gate.

barney hiprt backend: move barney's 12 device programs from the kept megakernel + function-pointer SBT to HIPRT's native 2-D (rayType x geomType) bitcode custom-function-table SBT. Backend 2 ships the megakernel cut (HIPRT does BVH+traversal only, barney's CH/AH/intersect run in-kernel via the SBT pointers); this is the more-native end state, not needed for correctness.
Prep PyTorch hipify mappings for CUBLAS_COMPUTE_16F + cublasMath_t enum (missing; needed by dgSPARSE and others). Verified patch + PR draft ready; needs a fork, a push and an upstream PR.

~65 ports pin CMAKE_HIP_ARCHITECTURES=gfx90a before enable_language(HIP), preempting host GPU auto-detect -> non-gfx90a AMD users who omit -DCMAKE_HIP_ARCHITECTURES silently get gfx90a binaries that fail at runtime. Fix = auto-detect + dedup + gfx90a fallback only when no GPU (validated in UCM b697824, carries forward source-class). Audit all ports; PRIORITIZE open PRs; SKIP RAPIDS (ROCm-DS); verify each match is our code not vendored.

Resolved 2026-08-06. Five dependency forks that carried port branches without being tracked are now projects in the organisation: rmagine, opencv, diff-surfel-rasterizations and diff-surfel-tracing, with instant-ngp-kf determined non-contributable and deleted. Each records why its platform row is empty and where its validation actually lives.

merge_status.py _merge_lock release-inference can erase a concurrent lock acquisition: on port/rmcl, gfx1100's enter-porting (518e11b, 02:21:53Z) merged against the 33s-earlier review release (6b4caf7) and landed with no porting key and stage unchanged, so gfx942 acquired the same lock at 02:23:16Z (ecc160e) and two porters ran the same fix round concurrently. force-with-lease stopped the second push; no work lost. The heuristic at merge_status.py:123 treats any lock-less side with later updated_at as a release, which misfires when the lock-less record was written concurrently rather than after. Needs a person's ruling on the fix (e.g. explicit release marker instead of inference) before the next parallel round.
